projects.title: Lyceum
projects.description:
This is a Class/Course Scheduling/Management system that aims to allow instructors to manage, contact, and award students.

Language Stack:
 - ReactJS (administrator front-end / partial public front-end)
 - ASP Classic (server-side apis / primary public front-end) *required by client
 - NodeJS (secondary server-side email handling)
 - MySQL (primary database)

Current Capabilities:
 - it has the ability to create, and manage courses with classes
 - ability to email users that are enrolled in classes
 - ability to automatically email users reminders of classes
 - ability to create waiting lists for full classes (and can automatically enroll users from the wait list when room opens up)
 - view statistics on course activity (# of people enrolling in classes, etc)

projects.title: Backstory Trivia
projects.description:
* Temporarily stopped work on this project (2019)

https://github.com/demitchell14/BackstoryTrivia
https://github.com/demitchell14/TriviaGameHandler

This is a currently unnamed project written in Javascript.
It is a 2 stage project, as I am making this, currently, for a local company, however after it gets situated in a decent place, I will convert it to a SaaS product
It currently consists of NodeJS w/ Express and Socket.IO as the backend, and React as the frontend. 
The idea is to create a manager/builder/runner that will host LIVE, multiplayer, trivia games, all ran from either your computer, or your mobile devices. It is currently being developed for a local brewery that hosts live trivia competitions every week, however, it is done on paper. this will be an alternative.

Trivia Game Controller is currently open source and is the Project URL. The rest of the project is closed source currently, however, if any are interested in reading, let me know and I can send an invitation.
